name: Advise Project Approach
summary: Make project decisions with evidence, clear tradeoffs, and a plan you can act on.
description: A research-driven workflow for deciding what to build, choosing an approach, or finding your next move in an existing project.
bestFor: Choosing a stack or architecture before you build.
Checking the direction of a project already in progress.
Comparing vendors, operating costs, and what to defer.
workflow: Understand your goals, constraints, and existing code.
Research comparable projects and relevant primary sources.
Compare credible approaches, including their tradeoffs.
Recommend a direction, next steps, and conditions that would change the decision.
prompt: Use advise-project-approach to help me plan a self-hosted bookmark manager. I'm a solo developer familiar with Python. Research comparable projects, compare practical approaches, and explain what I should build first.

install.label: Skills CLI
install.note: Requires Node.js and npm. Follow the installer prompts to select your agent.

note: This skill supports project judgment. Its published evaluations include limitations and mixed results; it does not promise universally better recommendations.
role: Research comparable projects, weigh the tradeoffs, and choose a direction you can defend.

name: Lean Engineering
summary: Small changes, bounded workers, and real evidence. Give every edit a clear owner.
description: A workflow for delivering small, reliable software changes with one accountable owner, TDD-backed evidence, and no recursive review loops.
bestFor: Fixing a reproducible bug with a focused change.
Implementing a bounded feature in an existing codebase.
Keeping checks and reporting proportional to the work.
workflow: Define a bounded outcome and inspect the relevant code.
Reproduce the problem or establish a useful acceptance check.
Implement the smallest reliable change; the owner makes the edits, bounded workers only gather evidence.
Run relevant checks and report what passed, failed, or remains unverified.
prompt: Use lean-engineering to fix this bug. Reproduce it, make the smallest reliable change, run the relevant checks, and report what passed and what remains unverified.

install.label: Skills CLI
install.note: Requires Node.js 22.20.0 or newer and npm. Choose your agent in the installer; add -g for global installation.

note: Pairs with Efficiency Skill: Lean governs ownership, verification and completion; Efficiency governs whether and where to dispatch. Eight Codex trials passed their acceptance checks in September 2026. No comparative benchmark against other workflows is claimed.
role: Make the smallest reliable change, prove it with tests, and keep one owner accountable.

name: Secure Launch
summary: A security checklist shaped to your project before it goes live, with approved fixes checked one by one.
description: A launch-readiness workflow that scans for exposed secrets first, builds a short prioritized checklist, applies only the local fixes you approve, and verifies each one. DNS and provider settings stay with you.
bestFor: Preparing a SaaS, API or internal tool for its first real users.
Catching exposed keys, open database rules, unverified webhooks and missing rate limits before launch.
Reviewing an agent skill or MCP server before you share it.
workflow: Scan for exposed secrets first, then read the project with any flagged lines masked.
Classify the project and build a short checklist: before launch, first week, and as you grow.
Ask for approval, then apply only the approved local fixes. Sensitive changes are approved one at a time.
Verify each change locally, then hand over the steps only you can take, such as DNS and provider settings.
prompt: Use secure-launch before I launch this project. Read the repo, tailor a short security checklist and a local verification plan, then ask for approval before changing anything.

install.label: Skills CLI
install.note: Requires Node.js and npm. Choose your agent in the installer; add -g for global installation. The bundled scanner needs Python 3, or an installed gitleaks.

note: A launch-readiness pass, not a penetration test or a compliance certificate. It never deploys, changes DNS or scans live hosts. In September 2026 Codex trials, the multi-tenant API case passed. The Next.js and npm package cases were partial because the Windows sandbox blocked builds and tests, and the Express case has discovery-only evidence. Mobile coverage is a starter set.
role: Check what the project exposes on day one, fix what you approve, and verify each change.

name: Efficiency Skill
summary: Keep the main model in charge. Delegate bounded work when the handoff is worth it.
description: A routing workflow that keeps the session model in charge, weighs delegation overhead, and distinguishes model tier from reasoning effort.
bestFor: Choosing an appropriate reasoning effort for a task.
Deciding whether a bounded subtask is worth delegating.
Keeping difficult judgment with the main agent.
workflow: Read the dated guidance for the current agent environment.
Classify the task and establish the minimum suitable model tier.
Compare delegation overhead with the work it would save.
Keep consequential decisions with the main agent and verify delegated evidence.
prompt: Use efficiency-skill for this task. Decide whether any bounded work is worth delegating, choose appropriate reasoning effort, and keep hard judgment and final review with the main agent.

install.label: Skills CLI
install.note: Requires Node.js 22.20.0 or newer and npm. Choose your agent in the installer; add -g for global installation.

note: Routing guidance is sourced from official documentation. In September 2026, twenty Codex trials passed their acceptance checks; six could not confirm the runtime worker model, and per-run costs were not captured, so cost savings remain unmeasured.
role: Send each piece of work to the right model and effort, and keep hard judgment in charge.
